title: 第七章 元宵灯会 三

content_zh:
椭圆形的小院子里假山小溪计时日冕应有尽有，一个穿绿裙的小丫头上来主动要帮他取下背上的剑。
“不用了。”林新摇头，“你先去帮我烧洗澡水。”
“好的大爷。”小丫头应了声，出了门，她是从小就一直照顾林新如的丫头，到没有什么生分的。
站在院子里，扫视一圈周围，林新从屋里找了根凳子放在假山边，一屁股坐了下来。
这地方是林新如的家，却不是他林新的家，坐在这里，记忆中有着熟悉感，但此时此刻却只有陌生。
他看着面前的水池里，几尾黄鱼摇头摆尾的缓缓游动着，水面上还漂浮着几篇不知道哪飞来的绿色落叶。
伸出手，林新手指伸进水池的水中，冰冰凉凉有些刺骨，手指在水面上激荡起几圈波纹，扩散开来，吓得几尾鱼赶紧窜到远一点的角落里。
林新摇摇头，听到外面远处传来客人进门的声音，似乎老二老三他们在陪同老爹林志文接待客人。还有门房不断的唱诺声，显然来人送了不少礼物。
“就这么呆着也太无聊了....”林新起身回房，取下背着的长剑，就这么不出鞘开始缓缓练习起来红松剑法，要将其练成本能可是需要不少时间。
一边练剑，林新心头一边在纠结，这次下来他可是打算购置药材，还有看能不能解决长耳虎的事。不过药材需要的钱可不是什么小数目，要是按照那个归元丹的方子配，起码要上百两银子才能弄出一副。道馆里上次打退横刀门的人，算是发了笔横财，零零碎碎加上把那些刀换成钱，吃喝用度到现在，还有二十多两的样子。远远不够。
“上百两银子....换算成物价的话，就是十多万啊....”林新心头越发纠结，就算家里是土地主大户，这笔钱也不是随随便便就能到手。
外面灰白的天色逐渐暗淡下来，那个绿裙小丫头终于端着一盆热水开门进来。同时进来的还有一个姿容秀丽的中年妇人。
“新如....”妇人身穿水红长裙，戴着一支凤头金钗，看得出年轻时候很漂亮。只是眉目间隐隐有股哀愁之意。仿佛一直皱着眉头一样。
林新一看就头疼了，这是他娘。不..是这个身体他娘.....赵玉娘。
“你又瘦了....”林心如他妈走过来轻轻摸着林新的脸。
“.......”您哪点看出来我瘦了....
这些天林新明显感觉自己胖了好几斤......
“这次回来，就别上山了。”赵玉娘低声道，“最近家里不太平，没有太多精力照顾你，山上野外又乱，我听说最近附近来了个江洋大盗，杀人不眨眼，连官府都奈何他不得，要是你们遇到了可就麻烦了。”
“江洋大盗？”林新立马联想到师叔伯云子，这家伙教导他们的那些招数可不就是十足的阴毒卑鄙下流。要说附近最强的江洋大盗，说不定还真就说的是这位师叔.....
“是啊，听说前几天，城东的一家小户，满门都被灭了，上到八十岁的老母，下到三岁小儿，一个没留，简直残忍。”赵玉娘拉着林新进屋坐下，小丫头端着热水打湿毛巾，一边给林新擦拭脸颊。

“没事的，我们可是习练武艺在身，又没什么油水，那江洋大盗就算是要抢也不至于先挑我们下手。道馆里一穷二白什么也没有。”林新随口道。
就算有，有伯云子师叔在，那一般的江洋大盗估计也不敢来。要知道这年头一个人敢大江南北到处跑还一点事也没有的，那都是身手强健，武艺高超之人，毕竟深山野外猛兽盗匪也不少，单身上路还能没事，可见一斑。
和老娘聊了一会儿，她直接问起安颖，一副很热心的样子，不过听她语气，似乎是打算让安颖做个妾，林新随随便便应付过去，好不容易才把她送走。
日落之后，林新带着安颖出门逛了下家里，这才朝着主院去了，元宵灯会过节可是要一起聚餐的。
顺着有些狭窄的天井，直接和其他人一起进了主院子的大堂。
大堂满是红漆的正中央，足有一个篮球场那么大，摆了两排单人单桌的位置。
从大到小，从长到幼，各人分别坐下。

content_en:
In the small oval courtyard, there are rockeries, creeks, timepieces and coronas. A little girl in a green skirt came up and offered to help him take off the sword from his back.
"No need." Lin Xin shook his head, "Go and boil the bath water for me first."
"Okay, sir." The little girl responded and went out. She was the girl who had been taking care of Lin Xinru since she was a child, until she had nothing to live for.
Standing in the yard and looking around, Lin Xin found a stool from the house and placed it beside the rockery, then sat down.
This place is Lin Xinru's home, but not Lin Xin's home. Sitting here, there is a sense of familiarity in the memory, but at this moment, it is only strange.
He looked at the pool in front of him, where several yellow croakers were swimming slowly with their heads and tails wagging, and there were also a few green leaves floating on the water that had flown from nowhere.
Stretching out his hand, Lin Xin put his fingers into the water of the pool. The ice was cold and biting to the bone. His fingers stirred up several ripples on the surface of the water, which spread out and frightened several fish into scurrying to far corners.
Lin Xin shook his head and heard the sound of guests coming in from a distance outside. It seemed that the second and third sons were accompanying his father, Lin Zhiwen, to receive the guests. There was also the constant singing of promises by the concierge, and it was obvious that the visitor had given a lot of gifts.
"It's too boring to just stay like this..." Lin Xin got up and went back to his room, took off the long sword on his back, and began to slowly practice the red pine sword technique without taking it out of its sheath. It takes a lot of time to perfect it.
While practicing his sword, Lin Xin was struggling in his mind. This time he planned to buy medicinal materials and see if he could solve the long-eared tiger problem. However, the amount of money required for the medicinal materials is not a small amount. If you follow the recipe of the Guiyuan Pill, you will need at least a hundred taels of silver to get one. The last time the people in the gym defeated the Hengdao Sect, they made a fortune, and after converting those knives into money, they still have more than 20 taels for food and drink. Not nearly enough.
"A hundred taels of silver... converted into commodity prices, it is more than 100,000..." Lin Xin became more and more entangled in his heart. Even if his family was a big land owner, this money was not easy to get.
The gray sky outside gradually dimmed, and the little girl in the green skirt finally opened the door and came in with a basin of hot water. Also coming in at the same time was a beautiful middle-aged woman.
"Xinru..." The woman was wearing a long crimson dress and a crested gold hairpin. It was obvious that she was very beautiful when she was young. There was just a hint of sadness between his eyebrows. It was as if he was frowning all the time.
Lin Xin got a headache when he saw it, this is his mother. No...it's this damn body...Zhao Yuniang.
"You've lost weight again..." Lin Xinru's mother came over and gently touched Lin Xin's face.
"..." How can you tell that I have lost weight...
Lin Xin obviously feels like he has gained several pounds these days...
"Don't go up the mountain when you come back this time." Zhao Yuniang whispered, "The family has not been peaceful recently. I don't have much energy to take care of you. The mountains and wild areas are also chaotic. I heard that there is a gangster nearby recently. He kills without blinking an eye. Even the government can't do anything to him. If you encounter him, you will be in trouble."
"The Jiangyang Thief?" Lin Xin immediately thought of his uncle Yunzi. The tricks this guy taught them were completely vicious, despicable and despicable. If you want to talk about the strongest gangster in the area, maybe you are really talking about this uncle...
"Yes, I heard that a few days ago, a small family in the east of the city was wiped out. From the eighty-year-old mother to the three-year-old child, no one was left. It was simply cruel." Zhao Yuniang pulled Lin Xin into the house and sat down. The little girl wetted the towel with hot water and wiped Lin Xin's cheek.
"It's okay. We are practicing martial arts and don't have much money. Even if the gangster wants to rob, he won't pick us first. The gym is poor and has nothing." Lin Xin said casually.
Even if there is, with Uncle Boyunzi here, the ordinary gangsters probably wouldn't dare to come. You must know that these days, there is nothing wrong if a person dares to travel all over the country. Those are people with strong physical strength and superb martial arts. After all, there are many wild beasts and bandits in the mountains and wilds. It is obvious that you can be fine on the road alone.
After chatting with my mother for a while, she asked An Ying directly, looking very enthusiastic, but judging from her tone, it seemed that she planned to make An Ying a concubine. Lin Xin dealt with it casually and finally sent her away.
After sunset, Lin Xin took An Ying out to visit the house, and then headed towards the main courtyard. They had to have dinner together during the Lantern Festival.
Following the somewhat narrow patio, we directly entered the lobby of the main courtyard with others.
In the middle of the lobby, which is covered in red paint and is as big as a basketball court, there are two rows of single tables.
From the oldest to the youngest, everyone sat down separately.
